categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies AddrMan address grouping and ASMap lookup routines.
categories.rationale: Optimizes AddrMan address grouping and ASMap lookup paths to reduce redundant network classifications and heap allocations. Benchmarks cited by the author demonstrate a 19.2% speedup in AddrManAdd and up to 40% reduction in IPv4 group calculation latency, representing a clear but deferrable internal performance improvement.
